Class PriceCandleBulkWriter

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.marketdata.history.PriceCandleBulkWriter
@Component public class PriceCandleBulkWriter extends Object
Writes a large set of new candles in one transaction, as fast as the database allows. Used by the history backfill, which writes a few million rows on a fresh database before the service is ready.

On Postgres it streams the rows with COPY, which loads them without per-row statement, JPA entity or index-lookup overhead - several times faster than even batched INSERTs, which matters most on the small VMs the stack is often brought up on. Any other database (the H2 the tests run against) falls back to saveAll.
